svg.title: Every organization moves human needs: the Economy of Wisdom quadrant with nine published placements
svg.desc: Four quadrants. Top right Transmuter: filters deprivation and amplifies fulfillment. Bottom right Absorber. Top left Magnifier: amplifies both. Bottom left Extractor: amplifies deprivation while absorbing fulfillment. Nine dots drift in to their published places: UBC, Ai2 (OLMo) and Quebec AI policy as Transmuters; Bill C-34 and Telus data centres as Absorbers; DeepSeek and Ontario AI policy as Magnifiers; Bill C-22 as an Extractor; US tariffs on Canadians on the line between Magnifier and Extractor.
